text:
maria: New micro-experiment: 'Playground Challenge' tied to launch posts + a short bench-and-build webinar. Offer a small credit only after they submit a runnable snippet in the playground. :sparkles:
kevin: Different from prior promos how?
maria: Two differences: credit is conditional on a runnable submission (signals intent) and posts include a compact benchmark callout (p95 latency + tokens-per-dollar) with a 1-click CTA to prefill the playground.
sam: Metrics: primary = 7-day engaged (did_run_challenge && made_api_call after). Secondary = webinar attendance, 30d trial conversion, median tokens/day.
olivia: Routing: webhook fields utm_campaign, post_slot, challenge_id, model_pref. Add classifier flag demo_candidate. Demo_candidate -> sales-assist; high-intent NA -> webinar priority; rest -> self-serve nurture.
emma: Two challenge variants: A = frontend streaming (latency focus), B = batch embeddings (cost focus). Test if matching narrative lifts conversion.
kevin: Factorial plan: narrative (bench vs story) x challenge (A vs B) x credit_delivery (in-play vs email) = 8 cells. Target N=800 signups over 3 weeks, cap to key markets.
sam: Events: playground.challenge_started, playground.challenge_submitted, playground.credit_granted, activation.flag, post.impression. Log experiment_id and cell. Example payload: {"user_id":"u_987","experiment_id":"EXP-3471112223","cell":"bench__A__inplay","post_slot":"twitter_1"}.
maria: UX: prefill playground scaffold + one-click Run & Submit. Track challenge_score and snippet_hash. Gate submissions to verified emails to reduce spam.
olivia: Routing thresholds: demo_candidate if classifier_score>0.7 && challenge_score>=0.6. Include challenge link in sales task.
emma: Copy ideas: bench: "See Redwood at <100ms p95 1x cost savings with caching 1-click challenge". story: "How Acme halved inference costs try the 5-min challenge".
growth-bot: Created EXP-3471112223. Webhook /webhooks/exp-3471112223. Allocation 8 cells uniform.
sam: Dashboard: funnel (impression->signup->start->submit->credit->activate) by cell, region, source. Also median delay signup->start.
kevin: Timeline: creatives + scaffolds by Wed, Run/Submit flow Thu, webhooks + routing Fri, dashboard next Tue, webinar Thu.
maria: Risks: social spike imbalance (monitor 48h), spammy submissions (email verify + rate-limit), playground abuse (IP rate-limits).
emma: Add 2-question micro-survey after submit.
maria: Actions: Maria -> creative/slides; Emma -> scaffolds; Kevin -> UX review; Olivia -> webhooks/routing; Sam -> tracking/dashboard; Growth-bot -> created. Sync Mon 9:30. :calendar:
